text.en: The new cart outside the library is selling a latte that smells like it was made by someone who actually cares. There's a line, but it moves fast.
text.zh: 图书馆门口新来的咖啡车，那杯拿铁闻起来像是有人真的用心做的。排队的人不少，但队伍走得很快。

resultText.en: Worth every cent. You float through the next two lectures.
resultText.zh: 每一分钱都值。接下来两节 lecture 你都飘着上的。

resultText.en: Fine. Caffeinated. The dream of the good latte lingers.
resultText.zh: 还行，咖啡因到位了。但那杯好拿铁的梦还在心里晃。

resultText.en: You make it to class on time, smelling everyone else's coffee with great sadness.
resultText.zh: 你准时进了教室，闻着同学们的咖啡，心里有点酸。

title.en: The Vending Machine Has Tasted Money
title.zh: 贩卖机尝过钱的味道了

text.en: You insert your last bill, press B4 for the granola bar, and the spiral turns... 95% of the way. The bar dangles, taunting you.
text.zh: 你塞进最后一张钱，按 B4 想买能量棒，螺旋转了……95%。能量棒就那么吊着，嘲笑你。

text.en: Feed it another bill to knock both down
text.zh: 再塞一张，把两根都顶下来

resultText.en: Two bars drop. You are now rich in granola, poor in cash. Worth it.
resultText.zh: 两根都掉下来了。你现在能量棒首富，现金赤贫。值了。

resultText.en: It surrenders the bar without crushing you. A small, dignified victory.
resultText.zh: 机器投降了，能量棒掉下来还没砸到你。一场体面的小胜利。

text.en: Accept the loss and walk away

resultText.en: A stranger later frees your bar and eats it. The circle of vending life.
resultText.zh: 后来有个陌生人把你的能量棒解救出来吃了。贩卖机生态的循环。

text.en: Your ID badge has vanished. You stand at the locked clinic door doing the full-body pocket pat that everyone recognizes and no one respects.
text.zh: 你的门卡不见了。你站在锁着的 clinic 门口，做着大家都认得、却没人尊重的全身摸口袋动作。

resultText.en: It was in the sim lab, clipped to a typodont. Mystery solved, dignity intact.
resultText.zh: 原来卡在 sim lab，夹在仿真头模上。谜底揭开，尊严尚存。

resultText.en: You get in, but spend the day badgeless and nervous about every door.
resultText.zh: 你进去了，但一整天没卡，对每扇门都心虚。

resultText.en: The front desk gives you a hilariously bad photo on a temp pass. You keep it forever.
resultText.zh: 前台给你办了张临时卡，照片丑得离谱。你决定永久收藏它。

text.en: The supply room is out of your usual gloves. The only size left makes your hands look like cartoon balloons, and your classmates have noticed.
text.zh: 库房没有你常用的手套了。只剩下的尺码让你的手看起来像卡通气球，同学们已经注意到了。

resultText.en: You commit so hard it becomes a vibe. Two people ask where to get the look.
resultText.zh: 你演得太投入，反而成了一种 vibe。两个人还来问你这造型哪买的。

text.zh: 去别的房间找合适的手套

resultText.en: You find your size two floors up, slightly winded but properly dressed.
resultText.zh: 你在楼上两层找到了对的尺码，喘着气但穿戴整齐。

resultText.en: Your fine motor work suffers a little, but the lab gets a good laugh.
resultText.zh: 你的精细操作受了点影响，但实验室笑得很开心。

text.en: You glance at your phone after one lecture. The class group chat has 147 unread, started by 'is the quiz today??' and devolved into meme warfare.
text.zh: 一节 lecture 后你瞥了眼手机。班级群 147 条未读，起因是一句"今天有小测吗？？"，最后演变成表情包大战。

resultText.en: Twenty minutes gone, but you laughed and learned the quiz is next week. Net positive.
resultText.zh: 二十分钟没了，但你笑了，还知道小测是下周。算正收益。

text.en: Answer the actual question and mute

resultText.en: You drop the answer, mute the chat, and feel suspiciously mature.
resultText.zh: 你扔下答案，把群设了免打扰，感觉自己成熟得有点可疑。

resultText.en: Your meme gets eleven reactions. You contributed nothing useful and everything emotionally.
resultText.zh: 你的表情包收获十一个回应。实用价值为零，情绪价值拉满。

resultText.en: You stay focused and miss the funniest day in chat history. A worthy trade.
resultText.zh: 你保持了专注，错过了群聊史上最好笑的一天。值得的取舍。

title.en: A Tooth Meme For The Ages

text.en: Mid-study, inspiration strikes: a meme so perfectly capturing the pain of memorizing every cusp and groove. Your thumb hovers over 'post'.
text.zh: 复习到一半，灵感降临：一张表情包，完美概括了背下每个牙尖牙沟的痛苦。你的拇指悬在"发布"上。

resultText.en: Instant legend. People quote it for weeks. You are now The Meme Person.
resultText.zh: 瞬间封神，大家引用了好几周。你现在是"那个表情包大佬"。

resultText.en: {partner} replies with three crying-laughing faces and 'frame this'. Cozy little win.
resultText.zh: {partner} 回了三个笑哭，外加一句"这个得裱起来"。温馨的小确幸。

text.en: Save it, get back to studying

resultText.en: Discipline! You actually learn the cusps. The meme waits patiently in drafts.
resultText.zh: 自律！你真把牙尖背下来了。表情包在草稿箱里乖乖等着。

text.en: The shared fridge contains a container labeled only 'DO NOT' — the rest of the tape has fallen off. It has been there, by your estimate, since the dawn of time.
text.zh: 公用冰箱里有个盒子，标签只剩"请勿"两个字——剩下的胶带掉了。据你估计，它从盘古开天就在那儿了。

resultText.en: It's just very old rice. You toss it and become a quiet hero of the breakroom.
resultText.zh: 其实只是放很久的米饭。你扔了它，成了休息室里无名的英雄。

resultText.en: You make your own lunch space elsewhere. The container lives to haunt another day.
resultText.zh: 你在别处给午饭找了块地。那个盒子又活过了一天，继续作祟。

text.zh: 贴张阴阳怪气的便利贴

resultText.en: Your note sparks a three-day comment war on the fridge. Riveting drama, zero calories.
resultText.zh: 你的便利贴在冰箱上引发了三天的留言大战。精彩绝伦，零卡路里。

text.en: You meant to text 'running late, sorry!' to your study partner. Autocorrect sent 'running latte, sorry!' Now everyone in the group thinks coffee is on the way.
text.zh: 你本想给学习搭子发"快迟到了，抱歉！"。自动纠错发成了"快奶茶了，抱歉！"现在全组都以为有奶茶来了。

resultText.en: You arrive with a drink tray and instantly become the group's favorite person.
resultText.zh: 你端着饮料托盘出现，当场成了全组最受欢迎的人。

resultText.en: Mild disappointment all around, but it becomes a running joke for a month.
resultText.zh: 大家轻微失望，但这事成了一个月的梗。

resultText.en: Three people show up expecting drinks. You learn to proofread the hard way.
resultText.zh: 三个人空手赴约，满心期待。你用惨痛的方式学会了检查文字。

text.en: The lot is full. You've circled four times. A spot opens, you signal, and a tiny hatchback materializes from another dimension to take it.
text.zh: 停车场满了。你已经绕了四圈。一个车位空出来，你打了灯，结果一辆小两厢从异次元冒出来抢走了。

text.en: Park in the far lot and walk

resultText.en: A brisk walk later, you arrive early, calm, and weirdly proud of your step count.
resultText.zh: 快走一段后，你早到了，心情平静，还莫名为步数感到骄傲。

resultText.en: Money spent, sanity saved. The covered spot feels like luxury.
resultText.zh: 花了钱，保住了理智。有顶的车位感觉像奢侈品。

resultText.en: Twenty minutes later you win a spot through sheer spite. Late, but victorious.
resultText.zh: 二十分钟后你纯靠一口气抢到了车位。迟到了，但赢了。

text.en: Reaching into your white coat pocket for a pen, you find a folded five-dollar bill you have no memory of. Past-you left a gift.
text.zh: 你伸手到白大褂口袋里摸笔，摸出一张折好的五块钱，完全不记得是怎么来的。过去的你留了份礼物。

resultText.en: Free-feeling snack money tastes the best. You thank past-you sincerely.
resultText.zh: 意外之财买的零食最香。你真心感谢了过去的自己。

resultText.en: You grab {partner} a little something. The look on their face was worth far more than five.
resultText.zh: 你给 {partner} 带了点小东西。对方的表情远比五块钱值钱。

resultText.en: You pocket it again for future-you. The cycle of fiver continues.
resultText.zh: 你又把它塞回口袋，留给未来的自己。五块钱的循环继续。
